liveInjectionYield.note: The v0.6.0 receipt recorded liveInjectionYield as NOT_PROVEN and said it would be checked after release. It was, and real sessions injected memory. This is cited as prior live evidence about v0.6.0, not as an observation of these gates: nothing in this run touched the real root, and the isolation check proves it did not. It is also not evidence that 0.6.2 still injects, since the tier code it depends on changed in between.

releaseConclusion: Every gate in docs/VERIFICATION.md §2/§4 (eighteen for 0.7.0) passes on the clean candidate c336905d on its first attempt: real-root snapshot (160 files), typecheck, reproducible build, 151 files / 1623 Vitest tests, 283 mjs tests, installer, marketplace, packaged runtime (memex-0.7.0.tgz, 398 files, 9 MCP tools), lifecycle 9/9, 272 Workspace unit tests, 27 browser probes in English and 27 in Korean with 0 runtime errors, the i18n lint and key checks, isolated plugin validation, the regenerated benchmark under the new contract (PASS, equivalent to 0.6.0), the pack dry-run and the closing real-root compare (160 files identical). The three pre-release reviews' 20 findings are fixed with regression tests. Not proven here: the live overlay/model/language surfaces on the user root and the two-Mac round trip, verified after release.
